QUOTE: `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member` ... "By default the member is renamed to `private_nr`... The opt-out is for the library's own sources and its sample programs." and "`library/common.h:132` Unconditionally `#define MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS`... their struct accesses use the real member names."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer shows that translation units defining the opt-out see plain member names (library and sample programs), while default application consumers of public headers see the `private_` names.
